We need to write formative feedback for a student based on marking. Must address student as "you". Be specific, supportive, actionable: cite sections/figures, name what they did well, state what next rubric level requires. Do not change marks. Do not comment on document-conversion artefacts. Do not make up explanations for reasoning given by marking agent that is unclear or incomplete. Schema: summary <=80 words, next_steps array of 3 strings, criteria object with criterion id keys and feedback <=70 words each. Reply one JSON object only.

We need craft feedback per criterion C1-C4. Use marking reasoning and evidence. Need be supportive and actionable. Mention what they did well and what next level requires. For C1: Adequate 6/10. They have clear mission goals, users, rationale, references. Need explicit mission requirements (resolution, revisit, coverage) to reach Accomplished. Also R5 partial? R5 likely mission requirements? We can mention. C2: Adequate 5/10. Gantt chart and task descriptions feasible. Need contingency provisions and dedicated list of planned information sources; also plan should fit narrative and explain why plan developed this way. Also inconsistency weeks 7-8 vs 9-10? That's technical issue; can mention as actionable? It's presentation/plan detail. Also R2 partial, R6 no? R6 maybe information sources? We can mention dedicated information sources list. C3: Deficient 3/10. No technical results/calculations; only intention; major orbital mechanics error GEO at 600 km. Need preliminary results with brief description/interpretation to reach Accomplished. Also completed STK tutorials. Need correct orbital altitude. C4: Adequate 6/10. Well-structured headings, readable prose, Gantt labelled. Need reference list (not only footnotes), consistency between text and Gantt, professional formatting. Also abbreviation AOEs unclear? That's technical issue in project plan; could mention in C2 or C4? It's clarity. We can include in C2 next steps maybe define abbreviations. But criteria feedback limited 70 words. Need summary <=80 words. Next_steps exactly 3 strings. Need one JSON object only. No markdown. Ensure valid JSON. Use quotes. Avoid newlines? JSON can have strings. We can include <=70 words per criterion. Need not mention marks? We can mention current level? It says do not change marks; can reference rubric level. We can say "At Adequate..." etc. Need address "you". Good.

Let's draft.

Summary: "Your report presents a compelling coral-bleaching relay mission with clear users and rationale, and a readable structure. To strengthen it, add explicit mission requirements, a more detailed plan with contingencies and information sources, and preliminary technical results. Correct the GEO altitude error and include a reference list." Count words ~45. Good.

Next_steps: 3 actionable strings. Need specific. 
1. "Add explicit mission requirements (e.g., spatial resolution, revisit interval, coverage, data latency) and link each to user needs in the Mission Concept & Rationale."
2. "Expand the Project Plan: include a dedicated information-sources list, contingency provisions, and align the text with the Gantt chart (e.g., editing weeks 7–8 vs 9–10); define abbreviations such as AOEs."
3. "Produce preliminary technical results (e.g., orbit trade study or link budget) and correct the orbital altitude: GEO is ~35,786 km, not 600 km; document calculations and interpretation."

Criteria:
C1: "You clearly identify marine/conservation scientists as users and justify the mission with GBR bleaching and references. To reach Accomplished, add explicit mission requirements—resolution, revisit, coverage, latency—and tie each to user needs. This will complete the goals-to-requirements chain." <=70 words. Good.

C2: "Your Gantt chart and task descriptions show a feasible plan. For Accomplished, add contingency provisions and a dedicated list of planned information sources, and explain why the plan fits the mission narrative. Also resolve the text–Gantt inconsistency for editing weeks and define 'AOEs'." Count ~50. Good.

C3: "You have completed STK tutorials, but no preliminary technical results are presented. To move beyond Deficient, include a small set of results with brief interpretation—e.g., an orbit trade study or coverage estimate. Correct the significant error: GEO altitude is ~35,786 km, not 600 km; 600 km is LEO." ~50. Good.

C4: "Your document is well structured with clear headings and readable prose, and the Gantt chart is labelled. For Accomplished, add a proper reference list (not only footnotes), ensure in-text citations match it, and make formatting fully consistent—including aligning the text and Gantt chart on editing weeks." ~50. Good.

Need ensure JSON only. Use criterion ids "C1" etc. Summary <=80 words. Next_steps array length 3. Criteria object. No markdown. Good.

Need maybe mention "R6 no" not necessary. But next steps cover. Do not comment on document-conversion artefacts. Fine.

Need not make up explanations. We use marking. Good.

Final JSON.
